The top section displays a red standing figure (pedestrian stop), the middle is unlit/dark, and the bottom displays a green walking figure (pedestrian go). To the left, a portion of a secondary signal head is visible. The background consists of bare tree branches and a stone structure, indicating an urban outdoor setting in winter or late autumn.
